caption: The drawing features a symmetrical floral motif composed of stylized leaves and flowers in red, blue, green, and yellow. At the center top, there is a large flower with three main petals: the central petal is yellow, while the two outer petals are red with blue curving edges and a border of red dots. Beneath this flower, two smaller blue flowers with green stems and leaves grow outward on each side, each accompanied by a yellow, pointed leaf. Red organic shapes resembling leaves or flames extend diagonally upward from the middle section on both sides. The lower part of the composition has pairs of large red leaves and smaller green leaves curving outward symmetrically, all emerging from a vase-like structure at the bottom center, which is colored red and consists of interlocking loops. The background is a textured beige, and the phrase "FROM A SGRAFFITO PLATE 1810" is printed at the bottom center, with additional details printed in smaller text along the bottom edge.
title: Plate 2: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
